title: Adjustable Dog Car Seat Belt, Polyester and Zinc Alloy
bullets: Adjustable and stretchy, suited to all dog types
Length adjusts from a 70 cm minimum to a 125 cm maximum stretch
Polyester and zinc alloy construction for car rides
Elastic build gives the belt a bit of give on the ride
One pet car seat belt included in each order
description: If your dog rides along in the car, you want a belt that adjusts to fit. This elastic, adjustable pet seat belt is made for all dog types. It adjusts from a minimum size of 70 cm and can stretch to a maximum length of 125 cm. The belt is made of polyester and zinc alloy and weighs about 185 g net. Each order includes one pet car seat belt. Each belt ships in a plastic bag. Pet parents who want a simple, adjustable option for everyday car rides will find this belt a practical choice. Its stretchy design gives the belt some give, while the adjustable length helps you dial in the fit. If you travel with more than one dog, you can order a second belt. Ask yourself how often you drive with your dog, and pick a belt that suits your routine. Check the shipping estimate before you order.

faq.q: How do I know if it fits my dog?
faq.a: The belt has a minimum size of 70 cm and can stretch to 125 cm. It is made for all dog types, and the length adjusts. Compare these lengths with your dog's needs before you order.

faq.q: What is the belt made of?
faq.a: It is made of polyester and zinc alloy, and weighs about 185 g net.
